marker_reviews.reason: DROP TRIGGER removes trg_resolve_sku_file_used from public.sku_files_used; the per-row fuzzy resolve it fired is not a licensor statement and broke the historical parse backfill (shared-db #5092). The contract asserts pg_trigger carries no such row after the batch, so a surviving trigger fails exactly like a missing expected one.

DROP FUNCTION removes the trigger implementation public.trg_fn_resolve_sku_file_used(); nothing else calls it and the batch helper resolve_sku_files_used() stays callable on purpose. The contract asserts to_regprocedure resolves nothing for that signature, so a surviving function is a hard failure.
